short: Reaching customers through WhatsApp messages and broadcasts.
seoTitle: WhatsApp Marketing — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: WhatsApp marketing uses the messaging app to reach customers directly with offers, order updates and reminders. Part of the free Setu business glossary.
definition: WhatsApp marketing uses the messaging app to reach customers directly with offers, order updates and reminders. In India it typically achieves far higher open rates than email.
bodyHtml:
Why WhatsApp Marketing matters

It is the channel customers actually read, which makes it powerful for win-back and time-sensitive offers. It is also the fastest channel to abuse, and unsubscribes are permanent.

How WhatsApp Marketing works in practice

Send when there is something genuinely worth reading, segment rather than broadcasting to everyone, and make opting out easy. Respect the platform's rules on consent and message categories.

faq.question: How often should I message customers?
faq.answer: Rarely enough that each message is welcome — typically no more than a few times a month.

faq.question: What works best on WhatsApp?
faq.answer: Time-bound offers, order updates and win-back messages to customers who have lapsed.
